newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul interbank market closed for public holiday.
newsitem.headline: Seoul interbank market closed for public holiday.

text.p: Seoul's interbank market is closed on Thursday for the Constitution Day holiday. Trading will resume on Friday.
The South Korean won closed weaker on Wednesday against the dollar on fears of a tightening dollar supply in the wake of the financial crisis at the Kia Group.
The won ended at 893.50, down from Tuesday's 891.90.
One of Kia's main creditor banks, the Korea First Bank, said on Tuesday 18 of Kia's 38 affiliates, including flagship Kia Motors Corp, would be bailed out.
